name: patch_moves_2
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,re
src=open('src/ZeckMoves.lean').read()
src=src.replace("open Classical\n\nnamespace Zeck\n\nopen Finsupp (single)","open Classical\n\nset_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false\n\nnamespace Zeck\n\nopen Finsupp (single)",1)
# d lemmas
a=src.index("lemma d_odd")
b=src.index("/-- Even combine")
new='''lemma d_odd {i : ℕ} (h : i % 2 = 1) : d i = Nat.fib (i - 1) := by
  have hne : ¬ (i % 2 = 0) := by omega
  unfold d
  simp [hne]

lemma d_even {i : ℕ} (h : i % 2 = 0) (h2 : 2 ≤ i) : d i + 1 = Nat.fib (i - 1) := by
  have hp : 0 < Nat.fib (i - 1) := Nat.fib_pos.2 (by omega)
  have e : (if i % 2 = 0 then 1 else 0 : ℕ) = 1 := by simp [h]
  unfold d
  rw [e]
  omega

'''
src=src[:a]+new+src[b:]
a=src.index("/-- The combine as an equation")
b=src.index("end Zeck")
new='''/-- The combine as an equation on sums of singletons. -/
lemma doCons_add (x : Pos) {i i' : ℕ} (hi : i' + 1 = i) (h2 : 2 ≤ i) :
    doCons (x + single i' 1 + single i 1) i = x + single (i + 1) 1 := by
  subst hi
  ext t
  simp only [doCons, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Finsupp.update_apply, Finsupp.add_apply,
    Finsupp.single_apply]
  by_cases h1 : t = i' + 1 + 1
  · subst h1; simp
  · by_cases h3 : t = i' + 1
    · subst h3; simp
    · by_cases h4 : t = i'
      · subst h4; simp
      · simp [h1, h3, h4, Ne.symm h1, Ne.symm h3, Ne.symm h4]

/-- The split at an index `≥ 3` as an equation on sums of singletons. -/
lemma doSplitG_add (x : Pos) {i i' : ℕ} (hi : i' + 2 = i) (h3 : 3 ≤ i) :
    doSplitG (x + single i 2) i = x + single i' 1 + single (i + 1) 1 := by
  subst hi
  ext t
  simp only [doSplitG, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Finsupp.update_apply, Finsupp.add_apply,
    Finsupp.single_apply]
  by_cases h1 : t = i' + 2 + 1
  · subst h1; simp
  · by_cases h2 : t = i' + 2
    · subst h2; simp
    · by_cases h4 : t = i'
      · subst h4; simp
      · simp [h1, h2, h4, Ne.symm h1, Ne.symm h2, Ne.symm h4]

lemma doSplit2_add (x : Pos) :
    doSplit2 (x + single 2 2) = x + single 1 1 + single 3 1 := by
  ext t
  simp only [doSplit2, Finsupp.update_apply, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
  by_cases h1 : t = 3
  · subst h1; simp
  · by_cases h2 : t = 1
    · subst h2; simp
    · by_cases h4 : t = 2
      · subst h4; simp
      · simp [h1, h2, h4, Ne.symm h1, Ne.symm h2, Ne.symm h4]

lemma doA1_add (x : Pos) : doA1 (x + single 1 2) = x + single 2 1 := by
  ext t
  simp only [doA1, Finsupp.update_apply, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
  by_cases h2 : t = 2
  · subst h2; simp
  · by_cases h1 : t = 1
    · subst h1; simp
    · simp [h1, h2, Ne.symm h1, Ne.symm h2]

'''
src=src[:a]+new+src[b:]
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','src/ZeckMoves.lean'],input=src,text=True,capture_output=True)
print(r.returncode,r.stderr)
